newsitem.title: USA: 1996 insured property losses $7.35 bln-trade group.
newsitem.headline: 1996 insured property losses $7.35 bln-trade group.

text.p: Last year was the fifth worst year in terms of catastrophe losses, with 41 catastrophes causing $7.35 billion in insured property loss, an industry trade group said Tuesday.

Property Claim Services, a division of American Insurance Services Group, said catastrophes included winter storms that caused nearly $2 billion in insured losses and five hurricanes, the worst of which was Hurricane Fran causing $1.6 billion in insured damage.
Nearly 3.8 million claims arose from the catastrophes, compared to the previous high of 2.7 million claims arising from 34 catastrophes in 1995, the group said.
